reason: A DSH Web UI settings panel that locally reads session records and presents usage statistics through overview cards, an activity heatmap, daily token trends, and model-usage charts.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 增加用量统计页面，展示本地会话记录中的令牌、会话、消息、活跃度和模型使用情况。
summaries.en: Adds a Usage Statistics page to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI for viewing token, session, message, activity, and model usage data from local session records.

capabilities: Displays token, session, message, activity, and model usage statistics
